ticket.subject: Monthly to yearly billing
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

I'm the operations manager at Velloran SAS. We are on monthly billing for the Team plan and would like to switch to annual billing at the next renewal.

We have 17 users and do not expect that to change much. Nothing is wrong, we are just planning next year's budget.

Not urgent at all. Please let us know the steps.

Thanks so much!
Freya Brandt
operations manager, Velloran SAS
